semantics: Exactly what is shipped. The production artefact is a static directory served at the mount; the standalone file is the same product for offline presentation. No build timestamp is recorded: the build is deterministic (same commit + inputs → same sha256, checked by deploy:preflight and deploy:drill).

production.uploadInstruction: upload the CONTENTS of dist-deploy/kimyolab/ so that they are served at /kimyolab/
production.spaFallback: every /kimyolab/* path that is not a file → /kimyolab/index.html (see docs/DEPLOY.md §5)

standalone.delivery: one HTML file; opens from disk (hash routes, embedded content pack with the same integrity checks); external laboratories that need the network stay network-dependent and say so

learnerBundle.method: raw bytes of the committed learner modules (public/app-preview/**/*.js), the shared stylesheet and the standalone file
learnerBundle.note: deployment tooling is operator-side (scripts/, never copied into the artefact by the builder)
